Messages.Author: Kristyl Meth
Messages.Body:
One more question (there's always one more, isn't there?):

When a vamp at full capacity diablerizes a vamp with one blood on him, and
the dialberizing vamp gets a skill card from his controller's library, can
the diablerizing vamp take the pool from the diablerized vamp and be filled
to his new maximum? (I hope this sounds clear enough).

KM

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kristyl Meth wrote:
> When a vamp at full capacity diablerizes a vamp with one blood on him, and
> the dialberizing vamp gets a skill card from his controller's library, can
> the diablerizing vamp take the pool from the diablerized vamp and be filled
> to his new maximum? (I hope this sounds clear enough).

The diabolist gains the victim's blood (and the excess drains off)
[6.5.5.1] before his capacity increases [6.5.5.4].

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
In article <01bea0a3$703e5840$81a5...@dapatrin.riderlaw.com>,

"Kristyl Meth" <dapa...@riderlaw.com> wrote:
> One more question (there's always one more, isn't there?):
>

> When a vamp at full capacity diablerizes a vamp with one
> blood on him, and the dialberizing vamp gets a skill card
> from his controller's library, can the diablerizing vamp
> take the pool from the diablerized vamp and be filled
> to his new maximum? (I hope this sounds clear enough).

No. First the diablist gains the blood, then he gains the skill.
If he was previously was at full he will be one short after
committing diablerie no matter how much blood was on the
diablerized vampire.

Carpe Noctem.
